sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: Multiverse Computing team-blog exposition Sep 29 (day-only) of ProvenanceGuard: source-aware MCP verification (claim→source routing, NLI support, attribution check, allow/block, RARR repair). Blog is the W40 event; paper arXiv 2606.18037 (Aug 27) is pre-window background; blog is NOT an independent result.
claims.context: HF team blog Sep 29, full body read (r2) — unchanged baseline.

claims.text: Method: trace ei=(tooli,sourcei,texti); centroid routing ŝ=argmax cos (1,500-char premise cap, 512-token NLI budget, historical 256 labeled); DeBERTa-v3 NLI + attention proxy (τ=0.35, ratio 0.70) + protected-value strict check + lexical rescue (0.55/0.85); RF calibrator (400 trees/d5/leaf8/weights/Gini/seed 20260607, threshold 0.65 on val F1 0.841); attribution family matching + fail-closed aggregation; RARR repair loop.
claims.context: Original paper FULL TEXT read via ar5iv r5 (§§I–V: interface/claims/routing/NLI/calibration/attribution/repair/corpus/labels/benchmark/adjudication/results/ablations).

claims.text: 281 frozen medical traces (synthetic/de-id, no PHI); 266-trace/2,325-label subset; 40-trace 361-claim held-out (LLM-assisted 2-judge + priority; human-expert ONLY on 361): block F1 0.802 (P 0.673/R 0.993, CI [0.664,0.900]), source acc 0.858/260, src+rel 0.681. Multi-source: 59Q/254 cases/2,587 rows/263 frozen claims; block F1 0.846, source 0.503, src+rel 0.229 (wrong-chart 0.127, count 0.179 slices). Baselines support-only: MiniCheck 0.783/RAGAS 0.758/AlignScore 0.662/SummaC 0.436. Repair 173→all (144 fallback); rerun 59→59 (2 fallback); 50/50 swaps detected. Scope bound: attribution factuality ONLY (no clinical-safety/parametric claims).
claims.context: Original paper results consumed (held-out + multi-source + baselines + repair + probes).

claims.text: Held-out 0.858/260 matches relay; src+rel 0.681 was relay-omitted; harder-benchmark 0.503/0.229 share the relay's 50.3% value but on different units (frozen claims vs pairwise rows — distinguished); adjudication LLM-assisted (human ONLY on 361); 256-token runs historical-labeled.
NVFlow PR#9 merged optional grounding stage; Berkeley poster.
